name: Characteristic-p Yang Dimension / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the $n$-singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm Y_p=n-1$ for every prime $p$, while log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the trivial class $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$, while $\mathrm Y_p=1$ for every prime $p$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions, uniformly in the fixed characteristic $p$.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Characteristic-p Yang Dimension and Log Shattering of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
